title: Independent Richards Temporal Numeric-Profile Qualification
purpose: Independently determine whether the source-bound raw pressure-head step-doubling observable can support a restricted, bounded and scientifically reproducible temporal numeric profile across materially different hydraulic states. The workunit must not select limits merely to release F-GC02.

calibration_context.known_result: state dependence is material; dry state is pre-asymptotically under-conservative at coarse fixed-horizon levels and enters a conservative regime only after additional refinement

held_out_gate_A.soil_and_geometry: same source-locked four-node homogeneous F-GC02/F-SI20 fixture
held_out_gate_A.top_flux_rule: minus initial hydraulic conductivity so each pre-jump profile is stationary
observables: successive raw pressure-head defect D_h(N)=max abs(h_N-h_2N)
remaining finite-reference endpoint error E_2N=max abs(h_2N-h_Nref)
maximum external and solver mass residual

gate_A_questions: Do all frozen held-out trajectories satisfy the unchanged hard mass gate?
Does the raw defect decrease with refinement before numerical-floor contamination?
For each held-out state and stimulus, is there a bounded refinement level after which the raw defect no longer underestimates the remaining finite-reference endpoint error over resolved levels?
Is any such entry level reproducible across jump sign and amplitude within a hydraulic state?
Does the required refinement remain bounded over the frozen held-out state range under unchanged 8/4 solver controls?
not_admitted_by_gate_A: general Richards temporal admission outside the frozen envelope
next_action: Implement and run held-out Gate A exactly as frozen. Persist raw rows and failures before interpreting or proposing any numeric profile.
